annotations.title: The three things to hear first, with what backs them

description: Picks the three findings a person should hear first from hundreds of candidates (fired book rule cards, rare chart facts measured against 5,000 ordinary charts, period and transit changes in the next 18 months, agreement across Parashari, Jaimini and KP) and returns a reading plan: headline insights, supporting claims, timing windows, cautions, 1-3 past windows to confirm, and sources. Each claim carries its facts, citations, base rate, confidence and school. Nothing common to most charts headlines, nothing that flips if the birth time is off by 15 minutes, and nothing about death, longevity, illness, fertility or separation. Narrate the plan; do not add claims to it.

seenClaimIds.description: Claim ids already told to this person; they rank lower.
